# Eco-Focused Cards

#### Designed to Reduce the Use of First-Use Plastic


Support sustainability goals while appealing to eco-conscious cardholders


## Become a part of the movement to protect the planet®


Demonstrate a commitment to more sustainable solutions through the use of payment cards that incorporate recycled materials into the card’s construction.


Together, we can help turn the payments industry into a positive force for sustainability by focusing attention on alternatives to first-use plastic.


#### As a leader in the U.S. market for eco-focused cards, CPI is proud to have sold more than 100 million since launching in 2019.


#### All of CPI’s eco-focused cards are:


#### Compliant with EMVCo


#### Certified by the major payment


#### Dual interface capable
